vv.title: Villager Verdict
vv.settings.title: Settings
vv.settings.help: Configure overhead markers, colors, auto-checking trades, range, shortcuts, and saved data.
vv.search: Filter villagers by profession, enchantment, item, level, or note…
vv.sort.label: Sort: %s
vv.sort.help: Click to cycle sorting (Recommended / Lowest price / Highest enchant / Nearest / Profession).
vv.filter.all.help: Show all nearby villagers in range.
vv.guide.navigating: Highlighting villager in the world. Click 'Cancel Highlight' at the bottom-right when done.
vv.guide.none: No villagers found nearby. Walk near your trading hall and click 'Refresh Nearby'.
vv.guide.noneAuto: No villagers found nearby. Walk near adult working villagers and they will appear automatically.
vv.guide.probing: Auto-checking trades… %s left. Please stand still and keep menus closed.
vv.guide.pending: %s villagers are Unscanned (trades not checked yet): click '▶ Auto-Check Trades' below or right-click them.
vv.guide.failed: Could not check %s villagers (blocked or too far). Walk closer and right-click them.
vv.guide.done: All %s nearby villagers checked: Keep %s · Discard %s. Click any villager to see why.
vv.guide.targets: Looking for a book or item? Click '+ Add Wanted Product', then 'View villagers' to see who sells it.
vv.start.title: How to use (3 easy steps)
vv.start.step1: ① Walk near your villagers — the mod finds them automatically (or click 'Refresh Nearby' below).
vv.start.step2: ② Let the mod check what each villager sells: click '▶ Auto-Check Trades' below, or right-click villagers yourself.
vv.start.keep: Keep — sells a key trade nobody else can replace, or is needed as a backup
vv.start.discard: Discard — every key trade they sell is already covered by a kept villager
vv.start.unscanned: Unscanned — trades haven't been checked yet, so we don't know what they sell
vv.start.click: Click any villager in the list to view all of their trades, the reason for their status, and who can replace them.
vv.start.gaps: ⚠ Key trades that still need more backup villagers:
vv.emptyNearby: No adult working villagers found nearby yet. Walk near your trading hall and click 'Refresh Nearby'.
vv.emptyVillagers: No villagers match your current search or filter. Clear the search box or click 'All' above.
vv.detail.replacements: Villagers that can replace this one (click to jump):
vv.uninspected: Trades not checked yet (right-click this villager or start Auto-Check Trades)
vv.replacement.line: %s → replaced by %s at (%s, %s, %s) (%s) · Click to view
vv.gap.priceUnmet: %s: all kept villagers have a base price above your cap
vv.scan.help: Immediately re-detect nearby adult working villagers and update their positions and levels.
vv.probe.help: While you stand still with no menu open, automatically checks nearby villagers' trades. Starting remembers auto-start for this world; stopping turns auto-start off. Never buys, sells, or moves items.
vv.edit.help: Lock this villager as Keep, or add personal notes and search tags (resets when leaving range).
vv.navigate.help: Close this screen and highlight only this villager in the world so you can walk to them.
vv.next.help: Select the nearest Unscanned villager in the list; then click '✦ Highlight' to find them.
vv.target.add.help: Save a product filter (for example: Mending book with base price ≤ 16 emeralds).
vv.target.editHint: Click to edit or delete this product filter.
vv.target.viewVillagers.help: Switch to the villager list and show only nearby villagers selling this product.
vv.emptyTargets: No wanted products saved yet. Click '+ Add Wanted Product' above, pick an enchanted book or item, then click 'View villagers' to see who sells it. Product filters only help you search and get alerts — they never change Keep / Discard decisions.
vv.editVillager.title: Lock Keep & Notes
vv.editVillager.statusLabel: How should this villager be handled?
vv.editVillager.tagsTip: Anything in Note or Tags can be searched from the villager list search bar.
vv.editVillager.scopeNote: Note: Locked Keep, notes, and tags apply only while this villager stays in range during this session.
vv.manual.AUTO.desc: Automatically decides Keep or Discard from key trades, base prices, and backup counts.
vv.manual.KEEP.desc: Always keeps this villager while in range; returns to automatic if you leave range.
vv.targetEditor.priceHint: 0 = no limit. Uses base emerald price before temporary curing discounts.
vv.targetEditor.searchItemHint: Type an item name to search (e.g. Enchanted Book, Diamond Chestplate)…
vv.targetEditor.searchEnchantHint: Type an enchantment name to search (e.g. Mending, Protection)…
vv.targetEditor.queryHelp: After saving, click 'View villagers' on the Find Products tab to see who sells this. Used only for searching and alerts — never changes Keep / Discard decisions.
vv.settings.displayTip: Tip: When a crowded hall feels cluttered, turn off 'Show Trade Summary Overhead'.
vv.settings.probeTip: Safety: Auto-checking runs only while you stand still with no menus open. It never spends emeralds or moves items.
vv.settings.autoServerHere.help: Automatically checks nearby villagers' trades whenever you join this world.
vv.settings.autoServerNone: Join a world first to change this per-world setting.
vv.settings.speedLabel.help: Use Fast in singleplayer; use Gentle on multiplayer servers to avoid rapid interactions.
vv.settings.speedFast.help: Checks one villager every 0.1s. Best for singleplayer.
vv.settings.speedBalanced.help: Checks one villager every 0.3s. Balanced speed and comfort.
vv.settings.speedSafe.help: Checks one villager every 1s. Recommended on multiplayer servers.
vv.settings.shortcutsLabel.help: Bind keys for opening this screen (F8 by default), refreshing, or toggling markers.
vv.settings.dataLabel.help: View or clear trades remembered by the mod across your worlds and servers.
vv.settings.advancedTitle: Advanced options (most players can leave these as default)
vv.settings.resetDefaults.help: Restore every setting to its original default (click Save to apply).
vv.settings.timeoutSeconds.help: How long Auto-Check waits for the server to send trades; increase on laggy servers.
vv.markers.help: Show glowing outlines and overhead text on villagers in the world; turn off to hide everything at once.
vv.statusMarks.help: Show Keep / Discard / Unscanned (or a compact symbol) above each villager.
vv.summaries.help: List villager level and top enchantments/items above their head so you don't have to walk up to them.
vv.notifications.help: Play a sound and show a popup when a wanted product is found or when prices, stock, or trades change.
vv.green.help: Color used for villagers you should keep (green by default).
vv.yellow.help: Color used for villagers whose trades haven't been checked yet (yellow by default).
vv.red.help: Color used for villagers whose key trades are already covered by kept villagers (red by default).
vv.radius.help: Only villagers within this distance are shown, marked, and compared.
vv.scanTicks.help: How often nearby villager positions and professions are refreshed when Auto-Find is on.
vv.autoScan.help: Automatically detect villagers around you; turn off if you prefer clicking 'Refresh Nearby' manually.
vv.backups: Villagers to Keep per Key Trade
vv.backups.help: Keep at least this many backup villagers for each key trade, always including the best level and base price.
vv.dataset.help: Leave as 'default' unless you want separate saved lists for the same world.
vv.shortcutHelp: Click an action below, then press a keyboard key or mouse button. Press Esc to clear.
vv.shortcutReadFailed: Could not read shortcuts file; original file was protected. Please check it and restart.
key.villagerverdict.manage.desc: Open or close the Villager Verdict management screen (F8 by default).
key.villagerverdict.scan.desc: Immediately re-detect nearby adult working villagers and update their positions and levels.
key.villagerverdict.mark.desc: Quickly show or hide all villager outlines and overhead labels in the world.
key.villagerverdict.navigate.desc: Highlight only the nearest Unscanned villager; press again to restore normal markers.
key.villagerverdict.probe.desc: Start or stop automatically checking nearby villagers' trades.
vv.refresh.help: Reload the list of saved worlds from disk.
vv.clearWorld.help: Clear remembered villager trades in the selected world only; wanted products are kept.
vv.clearServer.help: Clear remembered villager trades across every dimension of this save or server; wanted products are kept.
vv.cleared: Cleared saved villager trades in %s files
vv.dataHelp: Remembered trades are reused automatically when you walk near the same villager again. Clearing removes remembered trades so they will be checked fresh, while keeping your wanted products and settings.
vv.clearWorldConfirm: Clear all remembered villager trades in '%s'? Your wanted products will be kept.
vv.clearServerConfirm: Clear all remembered villager trades across '%s'? Your wanted products will be kept.
vv.probeExplanation: When enabled, the mod automatically checks nearby villagers' trades while you stand still with no menu open and a clear line of sight, then updates Keep / Discard recommendations. It never buys, sells, or moves items (and switches hands if you're holding a name tag or spawn egg). Enable and remember auto-start for this world?
vv.targetFound: Found a villager selling your wanted product
vv.tradeChanged: A villager's price, trades, or uses left changed
vv.reason.manual: You locked this villager as 'Lock as Keep'
vv.reason.coverage: Sells a key trade no other kept villager can replace, or is needed as a backup
vv.reason.redundant: All of their known key trades are covered by kept villagers
vv.reason.uninspected: Trades have not been checked yet
vv.reason.gap: Some key trades still have no valid kept replacement
vv.reason.noSignature: No key trades discovered for this villager yet
vv.feedback.scanUnavailable: Cannot refresh right now; please try again in a world
vv.feedback.scan: Refresh complete: %s nearby adult working villagers
vv.feedback.unavailable: Action unavailable right now; please try again shortly
vv.feedback.probeOn: Auto-check started; remembered for this world
vv.feedback.probePaused: Auto-check stopped; auto-start turned off for this world
vv.professionsHelp: Turn off professions you don't want to manage (such as Fisherman or Fletcher). Disabled professions are hidden and never marked red; saved trades are kept.
vv.color.cycle: Click to switch to the next preset color
vv.cancelNavigate.help: Stop highlighting and restore normal markers for all nearby villagers.
key.villagerverdict.cancelNavigate.desc: Stop the active villager highlight and restore normal markers; does nothing when not highlighting.
vv.replacement.help: Close trading and highlight both this villager and all villagers that can replace them; cancel anytime in management.
vv.replacement.partial: Only some key trades have replacements; check the remaining trades.
vv.replacement.none: No kept villagers nearby can replace their key trades yet.
vv.replacement.markersOff: Turn on 'Overhead Markers (Master Switch)' in Settings first.
vv.replacement.started: Highlighting this villager and %s replacement villagers; click 'Cancel Highlight' in management when done.
vv.replacement.startedPartial: Highlighting %s replacement villagers (only some key trades are covered).
vv.replacement.ended: Replacement villagers moved out of range or changed; highlight ended.
vv.detail.noSignatureTrades: No signature trades for this profession yet.
vv.books.search: Filter librarian enchanted books by enchantment name or ID…
vv.books.filter.missing.help: Show librarian enchantments that have not reached their maximum level among nearby scanned villagers (lower levels still count as missing).
vv.books.filter.owned.help: Show librarian enchantments that at least one nearby scanned villager sells at maximum level.
vv.books.filter.all.help: Show all max-level enchantments that librarians can trade.
vv.books.addTarget.help: Add this max-level enchanted book to 'Find Products' so you get alerted when a villager sells it.
vv.books.partialClickHint: Click to view villagers currently selling a lower level of this enchantment.
vv.books.missingClickHint: Click to open 'Add Wanted Product' with this max-level enchantment pre-filled.
vv.books.emptyMissing: All max-level librarian enchanted books are already covered by nearby villagers!
vv.books.emptyOwned: No max-level librarian enchanted books scanned nearby yet. Walk near your librarians and check their trades.
vv.books.emptySearch: No enchantments match your search. Clear the search box to see all.
vv.guide.booksProgress: Max-level books: %s / %s owned, %s missing (only max level counts as owned).
vv.guide.booksComplete: All %s max-level librarian enchanted books collected!
